groups.objective: Supply the actual common global frame from StdTied and the companion identity, then replace every local frame without changing iw or position compatibility.
groups.mathematical_task: StdTied must come from the actual global model. Given its orthonormal integer basis and BaseTied, the local argument should be short: L is contained in the standard lattice, the latter is contained in L^dual, and T L^dual is contained in L. Since p does not divide T, their local projections agree. This is stronger than LI5's independently chosen local frames.
